::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 1st [?1871]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library, De Coursey Fales Collection/3
:::

Dear Madam,
The Daisy Chain cot in which I am specially interested is in the [Belgravian Children’s Hospital](organizations/other_17.qmd) 1 Cumberland Street Belgrave Square[^1]  Anything addressed to [Miss Munro](people/person_2272.qmd) - at this direction, for the inmates will be gratefully accepted  The [Children’s Hospital at Great Ormond Street](organizations/other_3.qmd) has two [Aunt Judy](organizations/other_54.qmd) cots which seem to be always well supplied

With many thanks 
yours truly
C M Yonge

A little girl from this place was for two months at the Belgravian Hospital and was extremely happy

---

[^1]: An appeal for a Daisy Chain cot to be founded at Cumberland Street Children’s Hospital appeared in *MP* (1 January 1871) 92-5.
